description: This file contains the implementation of the jQuery blockUI plugin, version 2.66.0, which provides methods for blocking and unblocking UI elements and the entire page, including features like growl notifications and customizable styles.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by extending jQuery with blocking and unblocking methods, handling browser-specific quirks, and setting default styles.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates overlay layers and message containers to block UI elements or the entire page, applying styles and event bindings.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes overlay layers and restores the UI to its unblocked state, unbinding events and restoring original element positions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restores DOM elements to their original state after unblocking.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds or unbinds event handlers to suppress user interactions while UI is blocked.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Event handler to prevent user input and manage overlay click actions during blocking.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the first focusable element within the blocked UI.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Centers the blocking message within its parent element.

methods.name: sz
methods.description: Helper function to get size measurements of elements.
